'''Bloatgourd''' was a type of [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Fruit/Legends|gourd]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Dantooine" /> These gourds were served at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Cooking">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=daily|Challenge Dish: Ultimate Galactic Sampler|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bloatgourd was one of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] that players had to find on Dantooine to receive the "Dantoonian Culinarian" achievement.<ref name="Dantooine" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
